## Summary

Describe the problem and the change.

## Authority / security impact

State whether this changes permissions, capabilities, persistence, browser/native messaging, Git authority, or recovery behavior. Write `None` if not applicable.

## Verification

List the commands and evidence used to validate the change.

## Checklist

- [ ] Change is focused and does not include unrelated refactors.
- [ ] Tests cover changed behavior.
- [ ] Public behavior/documentation is updated when needed.
- [ ] No secrets or private runtime data are included.
- [ ] `npm run verify` passes.
